name: council-mcp
description: MCP server on Cloudflare Workers that puts a question to a council of frontier models and returns every answer

scripts.costs: wrangler d1 execute council --remote --command "SELECT date(ts/1000,'unixepoch') AS day, member, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(tokens_in) AS tokens_in, SUM(tokens_out) AS tokens_out, ROUND(SUM(cost),4) AS cost_usd, SUM(1-ok) AS errors FROM calls GROUP BY day, member ORDER BY day DESC, member"
scripts.errors: wrangler d1 execute council --remote --command "SELECT datetime(ts/1000,'unixepoch') AS time, member, provider, model, error FROM calls WHERE ok = 0 ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50"
